question: What does the 2017 Baler River conference abstract report, and do its fish-name strings have current Catalog of Fishes matches, without admitting study specimens or correcting the source?

source.title: Taxonomic Classification and Identification of Class Actinopterygii found in Baler River, Baler, Aurora, Philippines
source.proceedings: The 6th International Conference on Integrated Science and Technology (The 6th ICIST), Scientific Program and Book of Abstracts
source.authorLineAsPrinted: Santiago, Jaec C., Cruz, Antoinette S., Esteban and Noriel B.
source.affiliationAsPrinted: Central Luzon State University, Science City of Muñoz, Nueva Ecija, Philippines
source.reportedMethod: The abstract says fish were collected and classified using morphological characters and taxonomic keys, naming a Field Guide to the Freshwater Fishes of New Guinea.

method.nameAuthority: California Academy of Sciences, Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes; exact binomial queries accessed 2026-11-27.
method.procedure: Reviewed the publisher-hosted proceedings PDF's Baler River abstract on printed p.121. Queried two exact binomial strings, the exact Sillagino macrolepsis source spelling, and a separately labeled Sillago macrolepis spelling candidate. Direct Catalog HTML and SHA-256 receipts are retained in the ignored raw research directory.
method.limits: The Catalog establishes nomenclatural status only. The abstract provides no survey dates, station list, coordinates, sample counts, diagnostic character matrix, vouchers, or article-specific reuse grant. It does not verify specimen identifications, present-day presence, habitat distribution, completeness, fishery or catchability, diet, legal status, or user-safety information. The Sillago spelling candidate is not a correction of the abstract label.

catalogCrosswalk.name: Awaous melanocephalus

exactCatalogQuery.currentStatus: Valid as Awaous melanocephalus (Bleeker 1849). Oxudercidae: Gobionellinae.

catalogCrosswalk.disposition: catalog-current-name-match; name status only and no study specimen identity verified

catalogCrosswalk.name: Glossogobius giuris

exactCatalogQuery.currentStatus: Valid as Glossogobius giuris (Hamilton 1822). Gobiidae: Gobiinae.

catalogCrosswalk.disposition: catalog-current-name-match; name status only and no study specimen identity verified

catalogCrosswalk.name: Mugil sp.
catalogCrosswalk.disposition: genus-level-only; no species identity can be inferred; preserve source family spelling and do not expand to a species

catalogCrosswalk.name: Sillagino macrolepsis
catalogCrosswalk.disposition: source-label-unresolved; similar catalog candidate is recorded separately and is not a correction or specimen re-identification

decision.explanation: Keep the conference abstract as historical, research-only evidence. Preserve its source spellings and genus-level label. Catalog matches and spelling candidates do not verify Baler River specimens or grant permission to reproduce the abstract's records in Bangwit.

nextAction: Seek a full report, thesis, diagnostic record, or voucher trail for the Baler River study; if none is available, keep the four abstract labels held and continue independent Aurora river inventories.

sources.supports: Conference abstract wording, reported four fish labels, title, event dates, and printed page; not detailed sampling or independently validated identifications.
Nomenclatural status queries linked per label above; the Catalog does not validate Baler River specimens.
